For suspected vulnerabilities, follow [the security policy](https://github.com/JustUndef/secret-handoff/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead of posting details here. Use synthetic data only. Do not paste credentials, full environment dumps, or raw target output.

## What happened?

Describe the problem and expected behavior.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal steps using synthetic values and a local test program. Redact private paths and metadata.

## Environment

- Windows version and architecture:
- Invocation method (desktop, PowerShell, cmd, agent):

## Evidence

Include only fixed status categories, numeric exit codes, and relevant synthetic test group results. Identify any checks you could not perform.
